statement: You are given an integer array nums and an integer k. Return the k-th smallest value in nums, counting repeated values separately.

A max-heap of size k gives the answer in O(n log k): push each value, and whenever the heap holds more than k values remove its largest. After the last value, the heap holds the k smallest values and its root, the largest of them, is the answer.

examples.explanation: Sorted, the values are 3, 4, 7, 10, 15, 20, so the 3rd smallest is 7. The final heap holds 3, 4 and 7, with 7 at the root.
The two smallest values are 1 and 5, so the 2nd smallest is 5.
Sorted, the values are 1, 1, 5, 9, 9. Both 1s count, so the 3rd smallest is 5.
